name: shadertoy-vscode
description: ShaderToy VSCode - Live two-way integration between shadertoy.com and VS Code

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix vscode-extension && npm install --prefix browser-extension
scripts.ci:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix vscode-extension && npm ci --prefix browser-extension
scripts.check-types: npm run check-types:vscode && npm run check-types:browser
scripts.lint: npm run check-types && npm run lint:eslint
scripts.build: npm run build:vscode && npm run build:browser
